description: Two friends stand on a rooftop overlooking the city at sunset, wide cinematic shot.

spec.subject: Two friends, both in their late 20s, average height and build, one wearing a dark denim jacket over a gray hoodie and jeans, the other in a light tan bomber jacket, black T-shirt, and slim trousers; both with wind-tousled hair, no visible props.
spec.setting: A flat urban rooftop with a low concrete parapet, city skyline in the background, sunset sky
spec.action: They stand side by side at the parapet, facing out toward the city.
spec.camera_angle: behind and slightly to the three-quarter side of the two friends, eye level, wide shot, 35mm lens, both figures placed low and centered with the skyline filling the upper frame.
spec.lighting: Warm low sunset light, orange tones, rim light on the figures
spec.style: Digital sensor look with fine natural grain, warm sunset color grade with slightly lifted shadows, restrained contrast, inspired by contemporary urban drama framing with clean horizon lines and silhouetted figures.
